CREATE VIEW EDS.OM_TASK_ACTIVITY_DETAILS_View AS

WITH LATEST_OTR AS (
    SELECT OTR.TASK_NAME,OTR.PROCESS_DATE, MAX(OTR.CREATE_DATETIME) CREATE_DATETIME
    FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
    JOIN OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OD ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OD.TASK_NAME
    JOIN OM.OM_TASKS OT ON OD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME 
    JOIN EDS.LOAD_DATES ELD ON OT.TABLE_NAME = ELD.TABLE_NAME AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = CONVERT(DATE,ELD.MAX_LOAD_DATE)
    GROUP BY OTR.TASK_NAME,OTR.PROCESS_DATE
)   
, LATEST_OCAD AS (
    SELECT OCAD.TASK_NAME,OCAD.PROCESS_DATE, MAX(OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME) CREATE_DATETIME FROM OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL  OCAD
    JOIN OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OD ON REPLACE(OCAD.TASK_NAME,'_PRE_','_') = OD.TASK_NAME
    JOIN OM.OM_TASKS OT ON OD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = OT.TASK_NAME 
    JOIN EDS.LOAD_DATES ELD ON OT.TABLE_NAME = ELD.TABLE_NAME AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = CONVERT(DATE,ELD.MAX_LOAD_DATE)
    GROUP BY OCAD.TASK_NAME,OCAD.PROCESS_DATE
)
SELECT DISTINCT OTR.PIPELINE_RUNID AS WORKFLOW_PIPELINE_RUNID,OCAD.PIPELINE_RUNID AS ACTIVITY_PIPELINE_RUNID,OCAD.TASK_NAME,OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,OT.TABLE_NAME,OS.[STATUS],OTR.PROCESS_DATE,OTR.TGT_RECCOUNT,OCAD.ROWSREAD,OCAD.ROWSCOPIED,OCAD.ROWSSKIPPED,OCAD.ROWSREJECTED,OCAD.FILESREAD,OCAD.COPYDURATION,OCAD.DATAREAD,OCAD.DATAWRITTEN,OCAD.SOURCEPEAKCONNECTIONS,OCAD.THROUGHPUT,OCAD.REDIRECTROWPATH,OCAD.LOGFILEPATH, OT.DATA_LAYER,OT.SCHEMA_NAME,OT.SOURCE_CODE,OT.TABLE_TYPE,OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING,OT.MONTHEND,OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME,OTR.START_DATETIME,OTR.END_DATETIME
FROM (SELECT OTR.* FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
         JOIN LATEST_OTR LOTR 
         ON OTR.TASK_NAME = LOTR.TASK_NAME 
         AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = LOTR.PROCESS_DATE 
         AND  OTR.CREATE_DATETIME = LOTR.CREATE_DATETIME) OTR
JOIN (SELECT OCAD.* FROM OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL OCAD 
         JOIN LATEST_OCAD LOCAD ON OCAD.TASK_NAME = LOCAD.TASK_NAME 
         AND OCAD.PROCESS_DATE = LOCAD.PROCESS_DATE 
         AND  OCAD.CREATE_DATETIME = LOCAD.CREATE_DATETIME) OCAD
     ON OTR.TASK_NAME = REPLACE(OCAD.TASK_NAME,'_PRE_','_') AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE = OCAD.PROCESS_DATE
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASKS OT
     ON OT.TASK_NAME = OTR.TASK_NAME
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_STATUS OS
     ON OTR.STATUS_ID = OS.STATUS_ID
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD
     ON OTR.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME


ORDER BY 4,3
